test_groupby_filter_series: test the groupby filter method on a pandas Series to filter groups by a boolean condition
test_groupby_filter_dataframe: test the groupby filter method on a DataFrame to filter rows based on group-level aggregation conditions
test_filter_dropna_behavior: test the groupby filter method with dropna=False to preserve NaN groups in the filtered result
test_filter_scalar_bool_enforcement: test that the groupby filter raises TypeError when the function returns a non-scalar boolean result
test_filter_with_nan_values: test the groupby filter method with dropna=False to handle groups containing NaN values
